name: Grimtotem Spying
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.

adventurer, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.
narrative.objectives: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.

adventurer, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 25 to 28, 4,800 XP in all.

quests.name: Message to Freewind Post
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.

quests.name: Pacify the Centaur
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

quests.name: Grimtotem Spying
quests.objectiveText: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
